result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal carousel content is awkwardly clipped at the right edge and the fixed bottom navigation obscures the restaurant card beneath it.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the lower restaurant card, cutting through its image and hiding the rest of its content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so the final card can scroll completely above the navigation and device safe area.

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” carousel show abruptly clipped items at the right viewport edge, including a nearly blank partial category pill and truncated restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent horizontal padding and carousel spacing or snapping so partial items appear intentional and text is not awkwardly cut off.
